# Signet Artists

> Signet Artists delivers live entertainment for private events in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas. All provided in a variety of genres and configurations, effortlessly.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, Boulder, and the mountain corridor. No prices are published. What the pricing page carries is what live music costs in the Colorado market, each price with the source it came from, and Signet prices a specific night when the date is sent.

## Main pages

- [Wedding music in Colorado: ceremony, cocktails, reception](https://signetartists.com/weddings/): We play live music at Colorado weddings, with an acoustic guitarist for the ceremony, a jazz duo for cocktail hour and a DJ for the late night.
- [Corporate entertainment company in Denver | Signet Artists](https://signetartists.com/corporate/): A Denver corporate entertainment company: live bands, ensembles, a DJ and live band karaoke for holiday parties, galas, client dinners and mountain retreats.
- [Live music for private parties and dinners in Colorado](https://signetartists.com/private-parties/): Book live music for dinner parties, birthdays and cocktail parties at Denver homes and clubs. We can bring anything from a solo musician to a full band.
- [Daytime live music in Denver for senior living, memorials and brunch](https://signetartists.com/daytime/): Book live music during the day in Denver, from a jazz duo for senior living or a guitarist for a memorial to brunch music or a lunchtime sound bath.
- [Bands and musicians for hire in Denver](https://signetartists.com/music/): Looking for bands and musicians for hire in Denver? We have guitarists, jazz duos and trios, string quartets, party bands, mariachi, a DJ and Featured Artists.
- [Pricing: what a band costs for a private event in Colorado](https://signetartists.com/pricing/): In the Denver, Colorado market, a live band can run $2,500 to $8,000. Here's what changes the price. Send us your date and we'll get you a quote.
- [What live music costs in Colorado](https://signetartists.com/guides/live-music-cost-colorado/): What live music costs in Colorado: a Denver band can run $2,500 to $8,000. This guide sources each price and explains what goes into a quote.
- [For Planners](https://signetartists.com/planners/): Here's how we work with planners, including your personal point of contact, the certificate of insurance, the W-9 and the technical details venues ask for.
- [Live music at Denver hotel wedding and event venues](https://signetartists.com/venues/): Live music for weddings and events at hotels in Denver, Colorado Springs and Boulder, with the ballrooms and terraces and the acts we’d pick for each space.
- [About Signet Artists](https://signetartists.com/about/): A signet was a personal mark, pressed into wax to say who made a thing and that it was theirs. We think of it as the mark an artist leaves behind.
- [Check a Date](https://signetartists.com/contact/): Tell us the date and the venue. We'll reply with availability and an exact price within 24 hours.

## Acts

- [Tejas Singh](https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/): Tejas Singh sings covers for events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. He can start out as a duo and finish as a quartet on the dance floor.
- [Jazz Duo](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/): A Denver jazz duo or trio for hire for weddings, cocktail hours, corporate events and dinners, playing jazz standards quiet enough for easy conversation.
- [Dirty Flamenco](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/): Spanish guitar for dinner parties, birthdays and corporate dinners in Denver. Dirty Flamenco plays real flamenco as a trio, and you can add a dancer too.
- [Funk Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/funk-band/): This instrumental funk and soul band plays Denver parties and company after-parties as a trio of guitar, bass and drums, or as a quartet with a horn or keys.
- [DJ](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/): An open-format DJ for Denver wedding receptions and corporate parties, on their own or after the band, playing through the same sound system.
- [Musician DJ](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/musician-dj/): One performer DJs your Denver wedding or party and plays a live instrument over the mix, with one booking from the ceremony to the last dance.
- [Tony Medina](https://signetartists.com/artists/tony-medina/): Tony Medina plays blues, classic rock and originals for private events in Denver. He can play solo or bring a four-piece band to get people dancing.
- [Little Moses Jones](https://signetartists.com/artists/little-moses-jones/): Little Moses Jones is a six-piece 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop band, perfect for holiday parties, galas, weddings and birthdays in Denver and across Colorado.
- [Meghan Clarisse](https://signetartists.com/artists/meghan-clarisse/): Meghan Clarisse is an award-winning Denver country and Americana singer-songwriter. You can book her solo, as a duo or with her five-piece band.
- [Quadrasonic](https://signetartists.com/artists/quadrasonic/): Quadrasonic is a hard-hitting rock cover band from the Vail Valley, playing Pat Benatar, No Doubt, Nirvana and Paramore at Colorado weddings and parties.
- [Chelsey Webb](https://signetartists.com/artists/chelsey-webb/): Chelsey Webb, the 2025 Female Entertainer of the Year at the Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame awards, plays country, rock and pop as a duo or with a band.
- [Emily Barnes](https://signetartists.com/artists/emily-barnes/): Emily Barnes is an award-winning folk singer-songwriter who plays Joni Mitchell, Fleetwood Mac and her own songs. You can book her solo, as a duo or as a trio.
- [Roma Ransom](https://signetartists.com/artists/roma-ransom/): Roma Ransom is a violin and guitar duo from Colorado Springs playing Romanian and Eastern European folk, old-time ballads and swing at weddings and events.
- [Chantil Dukart](https://signetartists.com/artists/chantil-dukart/): Chantil Dukart is a Denver jazz pianist and singer who plays Nat King Cole, Ella Fitzgerald and jazz takes on soul and pop, solo or with her trio or band.
- [Afro House DJ](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/afro-house-dj/): A Denver DJ playing Afro house, deep house, amapiano, techno and electronic music, with live tabla on request, for after-parties, weddings and birthdays.
- [Last Consulate](https://signetartists.com/artists/last-consulate/): Last Consulate is one musician playing upright bass and guitar over downtempo electronics, for Denver corporate events, dinner parties and cocktail hours.
- [Live Band Karaoke](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/live-band-karaoke/): We bring live band karaoke to company parties and after-parties in Denver. A real band plays the 80s and 90s hits and hands the mic to anyone who wants a song.
- [Yacht Rock Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/yacht-rock/): A yacht rock cover band for Denver company parties, patios and birthdays, playing the Doobie Brothers, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates and Toto in harmony.
- [Millennial Party Rock Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/millennial-party-band/): A millennial party rock band for Denver weddings, 30th and 40th birthdays, holiday parties and after-parties, playing the rock and pop hits of the 2000s.
- [Americana Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/americana-band/): An Americana band for Colorado receptions, retreats and patio weddings, playing the Grateful Dead, Tom Petty, Nathaniel Rateliff and Gregory Alan Isakov.
- [Soul and R&B Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/soul-band/): A soul and R&B band for Denver holiday parties, galas, after-parties and wedding receptions: Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin, Al Green and the Motown songbook.
- [Mariachi Band](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/mariachi-band/): A Denver mariachi band in charro suits for birthday serenades, quinceañeras, anniversaries, weddings and memorials, playing rancheras, boleros and cumbias.
- [Solo Piano](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/solo-piano/): Hire a solo pianist in Denver for client dinners, galas and dinner parties, playing standards and covers at a level your guests can easily talk over.
- [Changes Jazz Trio](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/changes-jazz-trio/): A Denver jazz trio playing the standards with a modern edge on guitar, fretless bass and drums, for cocktails, dinners and galas. You can add a saxophone, too.
- [Firstwater](https://signetartists.com/artists/firstwater/): Firstwater is a corporate sound bath in Denver for wellness weeks and retreats, with seventy-five minutes of live sound healing while your people rest.
- [René Moffatt](https://signetartists.com/artists/rene-moffatt/): René Moffatt plays original folk and Americana songs for private events in Denver. Book him solo, as a duo or a trio, or with his four-piece band.
- [Your Bird Can Sing](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/beatles-sing-along/): A Beatles sing-along for parties, company events, weddings, community programs and senior living in Denver. Two musicians play, and everyone sings.
- [Solo Guitarist](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/solo-guitarist/): Hire a solo guitarist for cocktail hours, client dinners and private dinners in Denver. One musician can play blues, roots, jazz and Spanish guitar.
- [Singer and Guitarist](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/singer-guitarist/): Hire an acoustic singer and guitarist in Denver for cocktail hours, welcome drinks, dinner parties and small weddings.
- [Spanish Guitarist](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/spanish-guitarist/): A Spanish guitarist for hire in Denver, for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinner parties and birthdays, at a volume your guests can easily talk over.
- [Acoustic Duo and Trio](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/acoustic-duo/): An acoustic duo or trio for hire in Denver, with voice, guitar and upright bass, playing covers soft enough for everyone to keep talking.
- [Christmas Jazz Trio](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/christmas-jazz-trio/): A Christmas jazz trio for Denver holiday parties and December dinners, playing Christmas standards and jazz standards on guitar, upright bass and drums.
- [Classical Strings](https://signetartists.com/ensembles/string-quartet/): A string quartet, trio, duo or solo violinist for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, galas and memorials in Denver, playing everything from Bach to Coldplay.
